sourceRefs.needle: //! Original recurring CLI commands. All periods, source validation and issuance stay server-owned.
//! Original structured recurring operations over the common server-owned engine.
//! Source-shaped recurring contracts over the same admitted native company owner.
//! Explicit manual recurring generation shares ordinary invoice issuance and current authority.
//! Original recurring inputs over the shared immutable template and generation tables.
//! Service sales use the same admitted physical owner and namespace as human sales.

input.interpretation: Normalized successful-dispatch token model, NOT public JSON argv protocol. stdin represents parsed --input source for original create; generate/workspace constructs body from flags. Global profile and output metadata are resolved separately. Refused argv/error shapes are refusal/parseProtocol.

globalPreparation.order: main original_args::prepare_with_output -> original discovery/offline branches -> local_binding::prepare -> original adapter or run -> remote::run -> leaf. Native remote argv is opaque to original normalization.
globalPreparation.profile: Public global --local-profile PATH or --local-profile=PATH before --; duplicate/missing/empty and simultaneous --server[=]/--allow-loopback-http[=] refuse. Installs process-local verified private Unix transport; injects normalized --server and --allow-loopback-http. Exact origin, no TCP fallback or auto-start. Non-root equal real/effective Unix UID; canonical profile/workspace0700, descriptor regular0600 single-link <=4096 bytes with no-follow identity checks; owned0600 r.sock Unix socket <=103 bytes. Descriptor canonical workspace/profile/origin identity revalidated. Non-Unix refuses. Credentials still required.
globalPreparation.company: Original create/generate/list accepts explicit --company or RENTEMESTER_COMPANY after trim. ASCII slug otherwise local-profile-bound existing nonsymlink direct-child path; RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE is exact assertion only. Native remote leaves retain explicit company semantics; run-workspace requires explicit workspace assertion, never opens caller workspace paths.

http.note: CLI does not print HTTP headers. Product constructor exact content-type:application/json and cache-control:no-store; protocol middleware does not add success headers. Protocol incompatibility409 is application/json without constructor cache-control. Wire HEAD has no body and is not an alias of these CLI GET/POST leaves.

success.human: Same pretty JSON as JSON mode; create/generate/run-workspace have NO separate human text.

variants.when: local parse/shape/credential/origin InvalidInput. Original local invalid() omits code; original credential errors include code.
transport/server_refused/protocol/outcome_unknown. Native refusal body discarded except canonical email409/422; original valid422 receipt retained.
Validated original200 business ok:false or exact422 receipt. Runtime unavailable is original {ok:false,errors:[HTTP runtime unavailable]}.

refusal.preparation: original_args preprocessing errors: stderr invalid_input: <message>; see --help LF, exit2 (special missing-input plain diagnostic). local_binding error exit2 compact JSON stdout. Neither standardizes original adapter output.

messages.outcome_unknown: operation outcome unknown; reconcile server state before retrying
messages.invalid_input: invalid input: <static SDK reason>; leaf own exact safe reason

refusal.nativeBoundary: HTTP400 input/query/protocol,401 unauthorized,403 access denied,404 selection/path,413 size,422 safe notcommitted business,503 busy/clock/Owner/outcome_unknown. Human outcome preserves actual engine code/errors; service failure stages not_committed/outcome_unknown/committed usage and not_attempted/not_committed/outcome_unknown/committed business. Invalid credentials401/access403; unsafe stage or unusable connection503; rejection or business notcommitted422; else400. CLI projection above, not native envelope equivalence.

parseProtocol.argv: Global original_args moves two command words, accepts --name=value split at first = and literal attached values. --json wins otherwise last --format json|human; default pipe JSON/terminal human. Consumed formatting metadata is not a leaf flag. Duplicate value flags and repeated leaf booleans refuse; no positional words or terminator tail supported. --help before -- bypasses execution. Create reads --input FILE|- <=262144 bytes (take262145), parses Value object, rejects any confirm member then inserts confirm:true and REserializes. Thus duplicate JSON keys collapse in this adapter (unlike invoice lifecycle raw forwarding); SDK object check rejects positional arrays. Generate builds templateId/asOfDate/confirm from flags. Workspace builds trimmed assertion/date and confirm:true only after --confirm value trimmed case-insensitive yes. No actor/principal/request-key flags.
parseProtocol.transport: SDK explicit HTTPS origin or literal loopback HTTP only with --allow-loopback-http; verified local profile preserves private Unix transport. Private cookie/service file readers, no credential argv values, no redirects/ambient proxies/cookie jar; connect10s/total30s. Each send first negotiates public <=1MiB protocol manifest for exact method/path and rust-http-v1. Request headers accept application/json, origin exact configured origin, x-rentemester-protocol:1, x-rentemester-manifest: negotiated identity, x-rentemester-wire-profile:rust-http-v1; credential Cookie or x-rentemester-service-key mutually exclusive; JSON writes content-type:application/json. Bounded response16MiB; no response MIME validation in these JSON readers. No automatic retry.
parseProtocol.response: Original reader validates bool ok, errors string-array; ok:false requires nonempty errors and optional string code; ok:true requires empty errors, writes positive templateId+string appliedRules, list rows/count equality. Native422 only accepted if ok:false, nonblank string code, nonempty string errors, optional appliedRules strings and no data/rows/count/created/documentId/invoiceNumber/periodIndex/issueDate/dueDate/deliveryPeriodStart/deliveryPeriodEnd. Invalid422 -> server_refused422. Other non2xx discarded. Mutating5xx/408, chunks/malformed/oversize success -> outcome_unknown; read malformed/oversize -> protocol, chunk->transport. Native business200 ok:false remains original receipt; no standardization.
parseProtocol.body: Read does not read stdin; write remote reads at most native limit+1, validates object with SDK and forwards EXACT bytes. Native recognized duplicate Serde fields rejected; nested Value duplicate keys may collapse. SDK validates type, enum,const,required,known properties,string UTF8 byte lengths,numeric bounds,typed arrays; ignores pattern/JSON Schema unions/uniqueItems except explicit family checks. Source SDK shape is not semantic validation. Original create parses/reserializes collapsing duplicates; other original bodies constructed. Native derived Serde may accept positional struct arrays with no outer guard, but this CLI SDK object check DOES NOT. MCP object-global guard is separate, no MCP array acceptance inferred.
parseProtocol.familyChecks: Native manual name<=256 bytes/count1..120/terms0..365/manual only; source customer/current parties and VAT exact-number validation server-owned, mode defaults issue_month/count1/manual. Original defaults count1/channel manual/terms30/mode issue_month, full structured invoice validation and frozen source; SDK optional fields nonnullable even where native Option permits null. Scheduler indices SDK exact <=safe but native u32<=4294967295; distinct selection1..100 and lowercase64 hashes explicit; reasons ECMAScript trim<=1000 UTF16. Hosted executor identities explicit nonblank/no control <=4096, reason trim<=1000 UTF16, hash lowercase64. Email explicit ASCII recipient after trim<=254, exactly one @, domain dot, no control/whitespace/header delimiters; native also forbids backslash and quote. reason10..2000/evidence10..4000 trimmed UTF8 bytes and no controls, exact canonical messageId/lowercase hash. Date pattern is not SDK-enforced calendar validity; server parses calendar/asOf<=trusted today.
parseProtocol.originalOutput: output() always pretty JSON LF, exit2 stderr only even --json; other exits stdout even human. list human success is exact tabular exception; JSON mode and business failures remain JSON. Runtime-unavailable exit1 {ok:false,errors:[HTTP runtime unavailable]}.
parseProtocol.nativeHEAD: CLI sends no HEAD. Manual/original list early405 Allow:GET before body/credentials; scheduled path404 before Owner, hosted405, email status observation only (service usage possible). Wire HEAD body zero including middleware; constructor JSON is not wire body.

binary.representation: CLI JSON/text only; issued PDF remains immutable server source, no raw PDF/stdout or local file/open/download

paginationFilterOrder.query: Original list emits includeInactive=true|false exactly once; defaultfalse excludes inactive. Other selected CLI leaves emit no query. No cursor/offset/limit/filter aliases.
paginationFilterOrder.order: Native manual templates ORDER BY id including inactive; generations ORDER BY period_index. Original same id order after includeInactive filtering and removes generations. Email native BTreeMap messageId order then legacy successful rows BTreeMap messageId order. Scheduled rows template id order, occurrences ascending periodIndex BTreeMap; missed first100 and truncated/missedCount report full count (refuse latest index>1000000). History event id order. Workspace skipped archived/uninitialized in sorted slug pass first, then initialized targets sorted slug; unknown can omit remaining targets; gaps template id/period ascending, per-company default500 max5000, not global cap.
paginationFilterOrder.effects: Reads never dispatch or install scheduler extension; service reads charge usage and may write control metadata. Hosted plan observes configured executor/current authority, not permission grant.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.capabilities: CompanyDraftWrite. Held current Owner admission/namespace lease+company mutex; current credential-derived human/service identity, user/actor/binding policy, company membership/grants and workspace transfer/backup fences, exact supported installed schema and immutable JSON/PDF/source checks. Current journal/fiscal calendar/closed-period and invoice validation rules on issuance remain in shared sales pipeline; this invocation does not post a journal. No discovery grants authority. Revoked human or service cannot authorize fresh dispatch; a handoff already attempted remains auditable unknown even if final authority/result recording fails. Owner retires unusable connections; read and service usage may write metadata, not provider effects. Create/generate/list current human or scoped current service; service usage charged, original service_outcome returns result without usage/business on success. Workspace runner human cookie ONLY; fresh human ExternalSend for public delivery reservation; per-phase current authority retained.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: Read has no confirmation; native write needs bare --confirm and JSON confirm:true, no synthesized hashes/ids/recipient. Original create/generate invocation injects confirmation; original run-workspace requires value yes (trim/case-insensitive).
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: Email expectedStateHash required reconcile/retry; scheduler templateHash enable, expectedStateHash pause/resume/cancel, planHash catch-up/skip/dispatch/reconsent; hosted planHash consent or expectedStateHash revoke. These are exact current source/state review fences, no generic revision header or replay token. Manual/original no client revision token.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.semantics: Generation creates issued JSON/PDF UNPOSTED/UNSENT; ordinary create/generate/retire never sends or schedules.

retry.naturalDedup: No request-key receipt; create has no deduplication promise. Template/period generation returns existing original only after current active/source gates; retired refuses even existing. Claims without invoice evidence refuse. No expiring caller-key/tombstone recovery endpoint. Append-only invoice/delivery/occurrence evidence remains durable; correlation IDs do not authorize replay.
retry.readBack: Read recurring-invoices, invoices and documents with current authority; verify template/period/document identity and immutable JSON/PDF; absence under denied access/changed source never proves noncommit.
retry.unresolvedProvider: Generation creates issued JSON/PDF UNPOSTED/UNSENT; ordinary create/generate/retire never sends or schedules.
